title: 4/11–4/12 every Hetzner cron job died on its first line: `source .env` under /bin/sh (dash)
tier_reason: liveness failure of every cron job since the 4/11 cutover: the 1am grading, 2am reconcile, 3am data/preview chain and the 5-minute lineup collector did not run, and nothing alerted

contract.text: Each installed cron job reaches the bts CLI and runs at its scheduled time (1am check-results, 2am reconcile, 3am data pull/build/preview, 5-minute lineup-time collector).

mechanism.text: the hand-installed Hetzner crontab began each job with `source .env`; cron runs jobs under /bin/sh (dash on Debian), which has no source builtin, so every job exited with 'source: not found' before reaching the bts CLI

mitigated.action: crontab reinstalled on the box from scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh (an operator step; deploys do not install crontabs)

residual.text: the reinstalled 3am chain still failed: its `bts data pull` had no --start/--end (required since d991a79) until 28732c2 plus a reinstall on 4/14 (I-027)
deploys do not install crontab changes: a cron fix stays inert until `bash scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh install` is run on the box
no automated check covered the nightly chain until the blend_training health check (e74c485, 4/27: CRITICAL when tomorrow's blend pickle is missing at end of day)

watchdog.trigger: a scheduled cron job leaves no run marker in its log by its slot + grace (e.g. no check-results line by 01:30 ET, no 3am-chain completion by 04:30 ET), or logs a shell error before the bts CLI
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every installed job logs a completed run at its next scheduled time

evidence.what: the manually installed crontab used `source .env`; cron's /bin/sh (dash) has no source builtin; every job died with 'source: not found'; result-checking, the 2am reconcile, the 3am preview generation and the 5-minute lineup collector were silently broken since the 4/11 cutover
POSIX `. ./.env`, BTS-HETZNER markers, install/show/remove; documents the dash gotcha
head d5c466c, 2026-04-12T15:52:42Z, concluded success — the script reached the box; the crontab install itself is not a workflow step
the Hetzner setup ran at 01:08 on 4/11; the 3am cron on day N produces blend_<N+1>.pkl, and a missing pickle makes the next day's prediction fall back to a stale blend

notes: mechanism code is empty: the failing crontab was installed by hand on the box and never versioned
